notes.notes:
- fixes to the map
- fixes to the player
- new inventory system
- zombies now move and roam around the map
- first and third person updated
- new character model
- new zombie models
- new player and zombie animations
- new supply drops and lootable supply drops
- new fixes to netcode
- you can now host servers in SINGLEPLAYER or STEAM ONLINE for others to join or play solo
- SAVE GAME SYSTEM WORKS you can save or load a game now
- menu settings fixed all options WORK

and much more that cannot be covered here check out the new update!
